_comment: Active D18/F09 evidence: the pinned pristine recording executes seven ten-item save-owned reward volleys. Exact execution counts, four natural action-9 pickups and a matched countdown control bind the special action-9 branch and health effect; other attacks and lifecycle breadth remain open.

fixture_census.inventory_scope: Selected after recursively enumerating movies/Phase4 and the broader operator movie tree; the existing relevant recording was preferred.

movie.recorded_input_scope: all 16 digital buttons; no analog axes

fixture_census.classification_boundary: The filename and JSON serial are leads only. Pre-load save inspection, mounted pristine CUE/BIN hashes, typed actor state and natural replay carry the authority claim.

static_action9_handler.classification: hash-pinned pristine resident executable; byte-exact matching ASM exists, while src_re contact-walker C remains semantic/documentation-grade

runtime_identity.classification: save-owned Region-A runtime; exact save/media identity required; not staged provenance

matched_variant_control.control_rule: Both branches reset through cycle-neutral traceToFrame to an identical pristine target-970 RAM/register/cycle/PC/SP origin. Only u32 countdown 0x800B4CB4 changes 9->6; the next native iteration decrements it and selects the equality-to-five path.

bounded_interpretation.observation: Seven natural resets execute 70 save-owned allocator calls: 63 general-path calls, seven countdown-equals-five calls and 14 later resident grain-increment stores. Four natural action-9 handlers execute the exact health increment store.
bounded_interpretation.inference: The countdown loop emits nine action-20 grain contacts and one action-9 health-leaf contact per volley; four health leaves are naturally collected and each raises true health by one.
bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: At equal pristine target-970 RAM/register/cycle/PC/SP, changing only countdown 9->6 changes the next allocated slot-17 action 20->9 at the same emulator/movie frame, PC and SP with one fewer mutation-branch CPU cycle.
bounded_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Do not infer a universal collection/drop rate, health above the observed domain, complete Thud attack policy, or D18/F09 completion.

bounded_open_frontier.closed_here: Recorded-fight volley count, allocation count, action-9 variant selection, four natural action-9 health increments and natural action-20 grain-pickup frequency.
bounded_open_frontier.still_open: Other attack sources/damage curves, complete action-9 spawn and collection policy, visual ownership, initialization, retry, persistence, breadth and failures.
